headline: Man sentenced to death for child rape and murder in Cumilla
summary: A court in Cumilla has sentenced Billal Hossain to death and fined him BDT 1 lakh for the rape and murder of 9-year-old Yasin. The verdict was announced by Judge Abdul Hannan of the Cumilla District and Sessions Judge and Child Violence Suppression Tribunal.
details: A court in Cumilla has sentenced Billal Hossain to death and fined him BDT 1 lakh for the rape and murder of 9-year-old Yasin. The verdict was announced on Wednesday by Judge Abdul Hannan of the Cumilla District and Sessions Judge and Child Violence Suppression Tribunal.

The convicted individual, Billal Hossain, is the son of Harunur Rashid from Purnamati village in Cumilla's Burichang Upazila. He was found guilty under Section 9(2) of the Women and Children Repression Prevention Act, 2000 (amended 2003).

The case dates back to September 30, 2024, when Yasin, the son of tea shop owner Akkas Mia, went missing from Purnamati village. His family filed a missing person's report the following day after an extensive search yielded no results.

Four days later, Yasin's body was discovered by police near the Dhaka-Chattogram highway. A murder case was filed on October 6 against Billal Hossain and unknown individuals at Burichang Police Station.

According to the case statement, neighbors had seen Yasin having breakfast with Billal Hossain at a shop before his disappearance. Yasin had also told his mother, Khodeja Begum, that he was going to Nimshar Bazar with Billal Hossain.
caption:
A man has been sentenced to death and fined BDT 1 lakh for the rape and murder of a 9-year-old child in Cumilla. The verdict was delivered by the Child Violence Suppression Tribunal.

A court in Cumilla has sentenced Billal Hossain to death and fined him BDT 1 lakh for the rape and murder of 9-year-old Yasin. The verdict was announced on Wednesday by Judge Abdul Hannan of the Cumilla District and Sessions Judge and Child Violence Suppression Tribunal.

The convicted individual, Billal Hossain, is the son of Harunur Rashid from Purnamati village in Cumilla's Burichang Upazila. He was found guilty under Section 9(2) of the Women and Children Repression Prevention Act, 2000 (amended 2003).

The case dates back to September 30, 2024, when Yasin, the son of tea shop owner Akkas Mia, went missing from Purnamati village. His family filed a missing person's report the following day after an extensive search yielded no results.

Four days later, Yasin's body was discovered by police near the Dhaka-Chattogram highway. A murder case was filed on October 6 against Billal Hossain and unknown individuals at Burichang Police Station.

According to the case statement, neighbors had seen Yasin having breakfast with Billal Hossain at a shop before his disappearance. Yasin had also told his mother, Khodeja Begum, that he was going to Nimshar Bazar with Billal Hossain.
